policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and have conceded once while doing it.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Eckerd have lost three straight without scoring; their only goals came in the win that opened their season.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result at all, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's, among them the match against Barry, a fellow member.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Nova Southeastern won for the first time at Montevallo, having lost both home matches, to Carson-Newman and Lincoln Memorial.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Lynn are unbeaten but have drawn their last two on the road, after beating Mississippi College at home in their opener.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Henry Obi has made seventeen saves for Barry and conceded seven, without a clean sheet.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Rollins have scored ten and conceded eight, and are still unbeaten after two wins and a draw.
